modules.module_title: Carry out testing of cement, concrete, brick and block sample

pcs.pc_description: interpret the testing procedures for the construction materials such as cement, concrete, bricks, blocks etc. from standard lab manuals and IS codes, prior to commencement of testing
collect cement/ concrete/ bricks /blocks sample from the concerned lot of the construction materials
perform standard test on the cement sample to determine consistency, initial and final setting, fineness, soundness, specific gravity etc.
perform slump cone, compaction factor and Vee-bee test on fresh concrete as per standard test procedure
cast the cement cube and concrete cube in fields and laboratory as per standard procedure for compressive strength testing of cement and concrete
carry out test to determine compressive strength of cement cube and concrete cube as per standard test procedure
perform test on the brick sample to determine water absorption, compressive strength, efflorescence as per standard test procedure
perform test on the block sample to determine water absorption, density and compressive strength as per standard test procedure
record readings relevant to cement/concrete/bricks/blocks tests in standard performa as per applicability
store tested cement/concrete/bricks/blocks samples safely in laboratory for specified duration
ensure tested cement/concrete/bricks/blocks sample are reused or safely disposed

modules.module_title: Carry out testing of aggregate sample

pcs.pc_description: interpret the testing procedures for the aggregates from standard lab manuals and IS codes, prior to commencement of testing

collect samples of fine and coarse aggregates from the concerned lot of materials and carry out operations such as washing, weighing, measuring, sieving, tamping, oven drying etc.as per standard test procedure and applicability
perform tests on fine aggregates to determine specific gravity, particle size distribution, silt content and bulking as per standard test procedure

perform tests on coarse aggregate to determine specific gravity, bulk density, gradation, flakiness index, elongation index, crushing value, impact value, and abrasion value as per standard test procedure
record readings relevant to aggregate test in standard performa as per applicability
ensure tested aggregate sample are reused or safely disposed
store tested aggregate samples safely in laboratory for specified duration

modules.module_title: Carry out testing of soil and bitumen sample in laboratory

pcs.pc_description: interpret standard test procedure for soil and bitumen prior to commencement of test

collect samples of soil and bitumen from the concerned lot of materials and carry out operations such as washing, weighing, measuring, sieving, tamping, oven drying etc.as per standard test procedure and applicability
perform tests for water content, Atterberg’s limit, particle size distribution, specific gravity, compaction test and CBR test of soil as per standard test procedure
perform test on bitumen for content, specific gravity, ductility, penetration, softening point, flash point, fire point and Marshall stability as per standard test procedure
record readings relevant to soil and bitumen test in standard performa as per applicability
ensure tested soil and bitumen sample are reused or safely disposed as per requirement
store tested soil and bitumen samples safely in laboratory for specified duration as per reuirement

modules.module_title: Carry out field testing of soil and bitumen

pcs.pc_description: prepare field testing tools and fix all associated accessories for performing tests
perform test to determine rapid moisture content in field as per standard test procedure
perform test to determine dry density of soil by sand replacement method and core cutting method as per standard test procedure
carry out core cutting of bitumen from field to determine bitumen content as per standard test procedure
ensure proper packing and shifting of soil and bitumen samples to laboratory for further testing
observe and record readings relevant to soil and bitumen test in standard performa as per applicability
ensure tested field sample are reused or safely disposed as per requirement
store tested field samples safely in laboratory for specified duration as per requirement
